title: Schedule of the Deductible Share Carried by a Host
content:
The deductible share a host carries on a loss recovered against their Keyturn Host Payout Account turns on the protection plan in force under their Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment and on how long that enrolment has stood free of settled claims.

## Schedule of shares

| Plan in force under the enrolment | Time the enrolment has stood free of settled claims | Share carried |
|---|---|---|
| The Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan or the Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 730 calendar days or longer | 5 percent |
| The Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan or the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 365 calendar days or longer | 10 percent |
| Any other case | Any | 20 percent |

The share is taken on the appraised sum of the loss, and the resulting deductible is rounded half to even to two decimal places.

## Both sides of each threshold

The first row turns on two years or longer free of settled claims, which is 730 calendar days counted up to the day the correction is worked out: at 730 days the first row is met, and at 729 days it is not. The second row turns on a year or longer, which is 365 calendar days: at 365 days the second row is met, and at 364 days it is not.

Both parts of each row must hold together. An enrolment on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan that has stood free of settled claims for 400 days meets the plan test of the first row but not its 730-day test, and meets neither test of the second row, since the second row names the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan and the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan; it therefore falls to the third row at 20 percent. An enrolment on the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan free of settled claims for 800 days does not meet the first row, whose plans it is not written on, and does meet the second, so it carries 10 percent.

The records that settle both tests are the host's Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment, which carries the protection plan name in force on it and the day since which it has stood free of settled claims.
